description: This PHP script handles the editing interface for the contact-opportunity relationship in the SuiteCRM module. It initializes the necessary objects, retrieves existing relationship data if available, prepares search and form display elements, and outputs the HTML template for editing the contact-opportunity link along with associated JavaScript validation.

classes.description: Template engine class used to load and render HTML templates with assigned variables.

classes.description: Class used to generate client-side validation JavaScript for the form.
